source: iNaturalist research-grade observations via GBIF (species facets by radius)

parks.name: Bukit Timah Nature Reserve
parks.blurb: Old rainforest on Singapore's highest hill, with colugos, macaques, squirrels and flying lizards.

parks.name: Central Catchment & MacRitchie
parks.blurb: Rainforest trails around the reservoirs with monitor lizards, pit vipers, langurs and hornbills.

parks.name: Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve
parks.blurb: Mangroves with crocodiles, mudskippers, otters and flocks of migrating shorebirds.

parks.name: Kranji Marshes
parks.blurb: Freshwater marsh where purple herons, waterhens, frogs and dragonflies live.

parks.name: Pulau Ubin & Chek Jawa
parks.blurb: A village island with wild boar, hornbills, otters and the tidal flats of Chek Jawa.

parks.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
parks.blurb: Lakes and old trees with otters, monitor lizards, kingfishers and a patch of real rainforest.

parks.name: Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park
parks.blurb: A river park in the city where otter families fish and herons wait on the banks.

parks.name: Gardens by the Bay & Marina Bay
parks.blurb: City gardens on the bay with otters, sunbirds, kingfishers and monitor lizards.

parks.name: Labrador & the Southern Ridges
parks.blurb: Coastal forest and hill parks with orioles, sea eagles, squirrels and sunbirds.

parks.name: Pasir Ris Park
parks.blurb: Mangrove boardwalks with monitor lizards, tree-climbing crabs, herons and kingfishers.

parks.name: Coney Island Park
parks.blurb: A wild island park with casuarina woods, birds of prey and beach life.

parks.name: Sentosa & the Southern Islands
parks.blurb: Beaches, forest and reefs with hornbills, monitor lizards, sea stars and crabs.
